messages.subject: using vim with Deducer/JGR ?
parts:
Hi all. Really enjoying Deducer, and its pairing with JGR had the benefit of also introducing me to the iplots package. One fly in the ointment: is there a way to use vim as my editor with Deducer/iplots/JGR? For those of us who are at home in vim, editing is less than efficient in JGR.

Thanks!
Stephen

parts:

> Hi all. Really enjoying Deducer, and its pairing with JGR had the benefit of
> also introducing me to the iplots package. One fly in the ointment: is there
> a way to use vim as my editor with Deducer/iplots/JGR? For those of us who
> are at home in vim, editing is less than efficient in JGR.
>

If JGR and vim both implement file monitoring and can detect when a
file has been modified externally and propose to reload it from hard
disk, then you could open the file in both JGR and vim, edit in vim,
save, switch to JGR, reload from hard disk and then execute the code.
Such an artefact works in RStudio + Geany.
